name: chargegrid-intelligence
description: Baseline técnica do ChargeGrid Intelligence MVP.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n admin,pwa,api -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @chargegrid/admin-web" "npm run dev --workspace @chargegrid/driver-pwa" "npm run dev --workspace @chargegrid/api"
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @chargegrid/admin-web
scripts.dev:pwa: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @chargegrid/driver-pwa
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @chargegrid/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @chargegrid/admin-web && npm run build --workspace @chargegrid/driver-pwa && npm run build --workspace @chargegrid/api
